subject: Request: GCP Marketplace private-offer concession for Cloudlytics renewal
messages:
From: Dana Park <dana.park@cloudlytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: cloudlytics-deals@cloudlytics.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Request: GCP private offer concession for renewal (Cloudlytics)

Hi Priyom,

We're finalizing our renewal with one of our platform customers and want to move to a GCP private offer to simplify procurement. Quick ask — can Redwood approve a temporary concession on the published marketplace listing fee and a deeper off-invoice discount for year-1?

Numbers in brief: current ARR with Redwood is ~$410k, renewal start 2027-06-01, customer is asking for a 28% off-invoice discount for year 1 if we do a private offer through the GCP marketplace. They also asked that the standard listing fee be waived given the channel spend they commit.

Attached are the proposed private-offer worksheet and the customer note. We need Redwood confirmation by 2027-04-11 to stay in the procurement window.

Can you advise next steps / internal approvers we should include?

Thanks,
Dana Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Cloudlytics
(attachment: Cloudlytics_Marketplace_Terms.pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Park <dana.park@cloudlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: GCP private offer concession for renewal (Cloudlytics)

Marissa / Laura — looping you both in.

Dana, thanks for the note and for sending the worksheet. Quick context for approvers: the ask is two-fold — 1) waive the listing/publish fee, 2) allow a 28% off-invoice discount on year‑1 via a private offer.

Preliminary numbers I calculated from the workbook:
- Base ARR: $410,000
- Year-1 revenue with 28% concession: $295,200 (delta $114,800)
- Expected marketplace take and one-off publish fee (~$12k) vs. waived cost

Can Marissa confirm whether we have precedent for this magnitude of concession on GCP private offers for renewals? Laura, can you advise on marketplace publishing waivers and whether we can fast-track the listing exception?

I’ve attached the customer's proposed private-offer file for reference. If we can get decision by 2027-04-11, we can lock their procurement timetable.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(attachment: proposed-private-offer.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Park <dana.park@cloudlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: GCP private offer concession for renewal (Cloudlytics)

Thanks Priyom — reviewed the workbook and procurement note. Summary and recommendation below.

What Cloudlytics wants:
- Waive the standard GCP marketplace listing/publish fee (~$12k one-time).
- 28% off-invoice on year‑1 as a private offer (customer cites competitor pressure and consolidated buying).

Risks / considerations:
- This is a renewal, not a net-new logo; retention risk low if we refuse but competitive risk exists.
- 28% is outside our standard private-offer band for this segment — typical concession range is 10–20% for renewals.
- Marketplace listing waiver is negotiable, but we have a limit on publish-waivers per quarter to avoid channel-exposure.

Proposed concession (ask to Deal Desk):
- Approve a one-time listing fee waiver for Cloudlytics for this renewal (will count as a quarter waiver).
- Approve a 20% off-invoice discount for year‑1 (split the gap).
- Require a 12-month commitment and prepayment of 6 months to reduce churn risk.
- Include a clause: if Cloudlytics expands >25% ARR within 12 months, credit back 50% of the delta (earn-back).

Attachments included: proposed pricing table and recommended private-offer terms.

Action items for Deal Desk / Finance:
- Confirm whether 20% is within allowable approve-by-sales limits or requires executive sign-off.
- Confirm waiver capacity for this quarter for marketplace publish fees.

Priyom — Laura, pinged you on waiver process. Dana — if you can confirm commitment/prepayment terms, it will help us finalize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
VP, Marketplace & Strategic Deals | Redwood Inference
(attachment: recommended-private-offer-terms.pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Park <dana.park@cloudlytics.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: GCP private offer concession for renewal (Cloudlytics)

Marissa — thanks for the clear recommendation. I approve the concession with a small modification.

Decision: Approve the publish/listing fee waiver and a 20% off-invoice discount for Year‑1 under the following conditions:
1) Customer signs a 12‑month commitment and pays 6 months upfront.
2) Add the earn-back clause Marissa proposed (50% credit back if >=25% expansion within 12 months).
3) Legal to add a clause preventing stacking with other Redwood promotional credits.
4) Sales to log this as a formal marketplace waiver batch item for Q2.

Priyom — please send the revised private-offer terms to Cloudlytics and request an updated signature by 2027-04-15. Laura — coordinate publish-waiver booking with the marketplace ops team and confirm internally when counted.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
